entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `Http2Connection.ProcessPingFrameAsync` should validate PING-ACK payload #69710
  • Harden ClientCertificateMode config validation #69707
  • IIS in-process: first request can observe empty IServerAddressesFeature.Addresses before startup publishes bindings #69704
  • [Hardening] Cancel pending cookie renewal when principal validation rejects authentication #69701
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #69698
  • OpenIdConnectHandler.SignOutAsync should only use a saved ID token issued by its own scheme #69695
  • HTTP/1.1 infinite KeepAliveTimeout and RequestHeadersTimeout expire on the next heartbeat due to deadline overflow #69692
  • [WebtoolsE2E][dotnet watch with hot reload] "Exited with error code -1" is displayed when pressing Ctrl+C to stop ASP.NET Core web projects after installing .NET 11 RTM #69691

Closed

  • IIS in-process: first request after startup can get an empty PathBase because IISHttpServer.StartAsync registers callbacks before reading the virtual application path (10.0 regression) #69392
    10.0.x
  • Get rid of custom reference resolution system, use built-in nuget features #61775
    .NET 12 Planning
